name: @mcsherrylabs/pi-meerkat
description: Pi agent extension: announce a channel you control onto the meerkat announcements registry, and search what others have announced. Owns the announcement wire contract; wraps @mcsherrylabs/pi-evolver for the chain and the content cache.
